questions.prompt: main and origin/main point to different commits. Which explanation fits?
options: You committed on main, and a teammate's commit was fetched into origin/main; neither moved the other
origin/main is always one commit behind main by design
A clone gets a random older commit as origin/main

questions.prompt: What happened when you ran `git switch origin/main`?
options: Git refused: a remote-tracking branch cannot be checked out as a branch to work on
Git moved main to the same commit as origin/main
Git created a new local branch called origin/main

questions.prompt: Which of these moves origin/main in your clone?
options: Fetching from the remote (and pushing your own work to it)
Running git log or git status
